levels.title: Pink Gas
levels.beat: Opening: Kit asks if the pink gas is normal; Ade: do not touch the pink.
levels.babelIntro: Pink gas. Pretty. I see you looking at it.

commsBefore.text: The gas is pink. Is that normal?
ok ok ok, do not touch the pink. Whatever it is, do not touch it.
It is normal here. Feelings pool in gas, Kit. Hold the shape, and the feeling follows.

commsAfter.text: I touched it. It tingled. Do not tell Rhee.

levels.title: First Feelings
levels.beat: Teach: small feelings drift in. VANTA sends a time and a challenge.
levels.babelIntro: Feelings already? Careful, they are catching.

commsBefore.text: 38 seconds. That is my time on this cloud. Beat it, Catcher.
Who is VANTA? Why are they timing us?
Another Catcher. Very fast. Do not let the clock hurry your hands.

commsAfter.text: Fear, rage, envy. ok ok ok. I only ordered one of those.

levels.title: Glass Cloud
levels.beat: Core: pity and shame hang in the gas.
levels.babelIntro: Glass looks solid. So do most clouds.

commsBefore.text: Wait, why does the gas look like glass now?
Some feelings are clear until you hold them. Look twice.

commsAfter.text: Glee, pity and shame in one cloud. It is a very odd buffet.

levels.title: Heavy Air
levels.babelIntro: Heavy in here. Keep your head up, Catcher.

commsBefore.text: The air feels heavy. Is it me? Please tell me it is me.
It is the gas. Dark words weigh more. Go slowly.

commsAfter.text: Hm. Some words are heavy because we carry them.

levels.title: Slow Colour
levels.beat: Core: bright and sharp words mixed.
levels.babelIntro: Slow down. I am starting to watch you play.

commsBefore.text: Bright words and sharp words, all mixed up. Wait, how do you tell them apart?
Read the shape, not the colour.

commsAfter.text: Bliss, peace, spite. That was basically my last holiday.

levels.title: Still Pocket
levels.beat: Rest and mid: hope, calm, trust restored; Babel notices and speaks for the first time, in an anagram.
levels.babelIntro: Hmm. You stayed still. I noticed.

commsBefore.text: A still pocket. Take a breath. Your hands can be loose here.
Three gentle ones in a row. Is this a trick? For science, I am asking.

commsAfter.text: Hm. The next cloud is thicker.

levels.title: Undertow
levels.babelIntro: Pulled under yet? Surface, then. I will wait.

commsBefore.text: Rhee, you went quiet when Babel spoke. Wait, why?
Habit. Four words now, and they pull. Hold your line.

commsAfter.text: That one pulled me under, and I was not even there. I need a cracker.

levels.title: Hard Edges
levels.beat: Core: pride and anger, VANTA is dismissive of Rhee.
levels.babelIntro: Sharp ones now. Mind your fingers.

commsBefore.text: Sharp words, same clock. I did it in 36. Rhee reads cards. I read the clock.
VANTA is very fast. I am also fast. At lunch.

commsAfter.text: Hm. Speed is useful. So is care. Do both when you can.

levels.title: Aching Drift
levels.beat: Core: quiet, aching words. Kit spots Rhee's phrase in Babel's line.
levels.babelIntro: Quiet out here, is it not? I know that quiet.

commsBefore.text: A quiet one. I will talk the whole time so it does not get weird.
Take it softly. These ache a little.

commsAfter.text: Rhee, your clue card says I know that quiet. Babel said it too. Why?
It is a common phrase, Kit. Next target, please.

levels.title: Warm Front
levels.babelIntro: Cozy cloud. Do not nod off, Catcher.

commsBefore.text: A warm front. Wait, why does it feel like someone is looking after us?
Warm gas, soft light. I am not saying nap. I am saying horizontal.
Take the warm while it lasts. You will want it later.

levels.title: Deep Pink
levels.beat: Late: the gas thickens; VANTA is near.
levels.babelIntro: Thicker now. Even I lose track in here.

commsBefore.text: I am two rings ahead of you. Do not wait up.
The gas is thick enough to chew. Wait, why is it so cold?

commsAfter.text: One cloud left after this. Stay with me, Catcher.

levels.title: The Ghost
levels.beat: Encounter: Rhee recovers grief and her voice breaks. VANTA sets a last time. Tomas names a feeling.
levels.babelIntro: Two words left in this cloud. I know both. Do you?

commsBefore.text: Two words. 30 seconds, my time. Beat it.
One of these is old. Take it gently.

commsAfter.text: Grief. Grief is love with nowhere to go. I... forgive me. I need a moment.
I miss you. I am not scared.
